checks.title: Manual: organization Admin role assignments are minimized
checks.audit: gcloud organizations get-iam-policy <ORG_ID> --format=json. Count members with roles/owner, roles/iam.organizationAdmin, roles/resourcemanager.organizationAdmin. Confirm <= 5 named individuals.
checks.rationale: Organization-level admin roles span the entire GCP estate.
checks.remediation: Replace standing org admin with PAM-style just-in-time access via Conditional IAM or Cloud Identity Access Management.

checks.title: Manual: service accounts are not granted primitive roles (Owner / Editor)
checks.audit: gcloud projects get-iam-policy <PROJECT> --flatten='bindings[].members' --filter='bindings.role:(roles/owner OR roles/editor) AND bindings.members:serviceAccount'. Should return no rows.
checks.rationale: SAs with primitive roles can escalate across the project.
checks.remediation: Replace primitive role grants with predefined or custom roles scoped to the SA's job.

checks.title: Manual: service account keys are rotated within 90 days
checks.audit: For each user-managed key, run 'gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=<sa>'. Confirm validAfterTime is within 90 days.
checks.rationale: Long-lived SA keys are a top breach vector when leaked in code.
checks.remediation: Rotate keys: 'gcloud iam service-accounts keys create ...' then delete the old. Prefer Workload Identity Federation over keys entirely.

checks.title: Manual: Cloud Audit Logging enabled for all services in the org
checks.audit: gcloud organizations get-iam-policy <ORG> --format=json. Confirm an organization-level auditConfig exists with service=allServices and DATA_READ/DATA_WRITE/ADMIN_READ enabled.
checks.rationale: Audit logs are the bedrock of incident response.
checks.remediation: Apply an org-level auditConfig policy via 'gcloud organizations set-iam-policy'.

checks.title: Manual: log sink to immutable destination (BigQuery / Cloud Storage with retention)
checks.audit: gcloud logging sinks list --organization=<ORG>. Confirm at least one sink to an immutable destination with retention.
checks.rationale: Retained, immutable logs prevent tampering during incident response.
checks.remediation: Create an aggregated sink to a Cloud Storage bucket with Bucket Lock or BigQuery dataset with partition expiration.

checks.title: Manual: VPC default firewall does not allow 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH (22) or RDP (3389)
checks.audit: gcloud compute firewall-rules list --filter='direction=INGRESS AND (allowed.ports:22 OR allowed.ports:3389) AND sourceRanges:0.0.0.0/0' --format=table. Should be empty.
checks.rationale: Internet-exposed SSH/RDP is a top initial-access vector.
checks.remediation: Restrict sourceRanges to specific CIDRs or use IAP TCP forwarding for admin access.

checks.title: Manual: GCS buckets do not have allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers IAM bindings
checks.audit: gsutil iam get gs://<bucket> for each bucket. Confirm no 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' principal.
checks.rationale: Public buckets are a recurrent data-leak vector.
checks.remediation: gsutil iam ch -d allUsers gs://<bucket> (remove). Enable uniform bucket-level access to prevent ACL drift.

checks.title: Manual: Cloud SQL instances require SSL/TLS
checks.audit: gcloud sql instances list --format='value(name,settings.ipConfiguration.requireSsl)'. Confirm requireSsl=True.
checks.rationale: Without requireSsl, connections may use cleartext.

checks.title: Manual: Compute instances disable serial-port access
checks.audit: gcloud compute instances list --filter='metadata.items.key=serial-port-enable AND metadata.items.value=true'. Should be empty.
checks.rationale: Serial console allows interactive recovery; only enable on demand.

checks.title: Manual: Security Command Center Premium / Standard enabled at org level
checks.audit: In Cloud Console: Security Command Center. Confirm an active tier (Standard or Premium) at the organization level.
checks.rationale: SCC consolidates GCP threat-detection findings and posture assessment.
checks.remediation: Enable Security Command Center at the organization level via Cloud Console > Security.
